description: Source code for a custom test reporter class 'ListReporter' used in Playwright testing framework, responsible for displaying test progress and results in terminal environments.

classes.name: ListReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter class that displays test execution progress, steps, and results with color coding and dynamic line updates.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message if available.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of an individual test, assigns an index, and displays the test title.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Outputs standard output chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Outputs standard error chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step, displays step info if configured.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updates display with step duration and status.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles completion of a test, updates display with test result and status.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during reporting, outputs error messages.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test run, outputs final epilogue.
